title: Literature-bound FMC/SMVE equation authority and analytical preflight
purpose: Reconstruct and preflight the published finite-water-content / Soil Moisture Velocity Equation advection-like formulation before any SWAP5 trajectory comparison.

primary_authority.citation: Ogden et al. (2015), A new general 1-D vadose zone flow solution method, Water Resources Research 51, 4282-4300
Ogden et al. (2015), Validation of finite water-content vadose zone dynamics method using column experiments with a moving water table and applied surface flux
Ogden et al. (2017), The Soil Moisture Velocity Equation, JAMES 9, 1473-1487
primary_authority.role: SMVE derivation and analytical Richards-comparison authority

primary_authority.citation: Morel-Seytoux et al. (1996), Parameter equivalence for the Brooks-Corey and van Genuchten soil characteristics: Preserving the effective capillary drive

public_oracle.rights: CC0/public-domain dedication reported by University of Wyoming DataCorral

frozen_equation_identity.moisture_coordinate: finite bins in volumetric water content theta
frozen_equation_identity.falling_slug: gravity-only incremental-conductivity advance as published equation 19; not exercised in D12 preflight
frozen_equation_identity.capillary_relaxation: rank-order front depths monotonically without changing finite-volume water amount
frozen_equation_identity.mass_conservation: imposed by finite-volume accounting of all added/removed water; no hidden correction flux
frozen_equation_identity.effective_capillary_drive: HcM = integral_0^infinity K_rel(psi) dpsi; infiltration uses max(abs(psi(theta_d)), HcM) for the tested uniform-soil authority
frozen_equation_identity.approximation: SMVE advection-like term neglects diffusion-like term; profile-shape deviations are expected and are not automatically failure

discretization.rule: uniform theta bins over the active moisture-content range unless a later literature-bound comparator explicitly aggregates the sub-initial range as allowed by the primary paper
discretization.reason: Ogden et al. 2015 reports approximately 150-200 bins for accurate full-range infiltration-front representation; 200 is frozen before SWAP comparison
discretization.constitutive_sample: right edge of each theta bin, following the corrected published method

numerical_preflight.dynamic_integrator: forward Euler for process ODE checks
numerical_preflight.source: published preliminary guidance for equation 18 with explicit forward Euler

tests.requirement: Show algebraically/numerically that the one-bin infiltration-front equation reduces to the Green-Ampt form stated by the primary paper.
For finite B01 moisture states theta_j > theta_i, set H_j=abs(psi(theta_j)) and verify groundwater-front velocity is zero to floating precision.
Apply the published sorting-style capillary relaxation to a deterministic synthetic front vector and verify exact finite-volume storage preservation within the frozen tolerance.
Verify monotonic B01 retention/conductivity over the 200-bin grid and independently evaluate a finite positive HcM from the actual B01 relative-conductivity curve.
Reproduce the published Ross-Parlange/SMVE power-law ponding/surface-saturation time formula for A=2 cm/h, K1=1 cm/h, D1=100 cm2/h and n=3..9, and verify the leading-front identity zmax=A*t.

D13_gate.if_positive: Authorize a separately preregistered literature-faithful FMC hydraulic development comparator on a lower-boundary envelope directly supported by the primary papers.

initial_comparator_candidate.lower_boundary_preference: water-table / constant-head configuration directly represented by published groundwater-front equations
